sps-01:
nāgendrahārāya trilocanāya bhasmāṅgarāgāya maheśvarāya |
nityāya śuddhāya digambarāya tasmai nakārāya namaḥ śivāya ||
sps-02:
mandākinīsalilacandanacarcitāya nandīśvarapramathanāthamaheśvarāya |
mandāramukhyabahupuṣpasupūjitāya tasmai makārāya namaḥ śivāya ||
sps-03:
śivāya gaurīvadanābjavrṇdasūryāya dakṣādhvaranāśakāya |
śrīnīlakaṇṭhāya vṛṣadhvajāya tasmai śikārāya namaḥ śivāya ||
sps-05:
yajñasvarūpāya jaṭādharāya pinākahastāya sanātanāya |
divyāya devāya digambarāya tasmai yakārāya namaḥ śivāya ||
sps-06:
pañcākṣaram idaṃ puṇyaṃ yaḥ paṭhec chivasaṃnidhau |
śivalokam āvāpnoti śivena saha modate ||
